reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis aligns with known effects of moderate heat treatment on oxide layer formation and microstructure refinement in high-entropy alloys, although some details about oxide stability still need experimental confirmation.
reasons.testability: The proposed multi-condition heat treatment comparison with clear metrics (microhardness, wear rate, oxide film characterization) offers a straightforward and decisive way to confirm or refute the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: It provides a focused, practical experimental plan directly addressing high-temperature wear of FeNiCrCoCu coatings and yields insights into material design parameters.
